name: abo-benchmark-tv
description: A dataset/benchmark (hosted by ghuijo) for evaluating models on TV-related ABO tasks (likely appearance/attribute or object benchmarks); it measures model performance on visual recognition or retrieval tasks in a TV-related domain. It is intended for assessing visual understanding and attribute/instance matching in media/television imagery.
reputation: Small/niche Hugging Face dataset with limited community adoption outside its creators.
